تعتورون (form VIII)
# تَعْتَوِرُونَ (taʕtawirūna) /taʕ.ta.wi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
# تُعْتَوَرُونَ (tuʕtawarūna) /tuʕ.ta.wa.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
